summary: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group filed a Form 6-K incorporating by reference a legal opinion regarding a debt issuance of $3.0 billion aggregate principal amount of senior callable notes across six tranches, including floating-rate and fixed-to-fixed reset rate notes due from 2030 to 2047. The offering was made under an existing F-3 shelf registration statement and an underwriting agreement dated July 13, 2026. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, restructuring, or other event-driven category is present. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction by a foreign private issuer, with no change of control, strategic review, or transformative event involved.
